headline: On last trading day: Indian market extended 4-week rally as Sensex and Nifty hit 9-month highs

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Record FII buying helped Indian benchmark indices hit 9-month highs and extend their rally to 4 weeks.
Banking, auto, and IT stocks provided strong support to drive market recoveries across recent sessions.
Draft GST changes proposed by CBIC aim to protect genuine buyers from input tax credit losses.
Global market cues, including Fed rate hike signals and an AI stock selloff, created brief downside pressures.
whatHappening: IndusInd Bank terminated the services of Sumant Kathpalia and invoked clawback provisions.
Sensex and Nifty50 capped a 4-week winning streak with 3% gains, while Nifty Smallcap 100 underperformed.
RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra urged commercial banks to increase lending to small businesses.
Asian and US market selloffs in tech and AI stocks weighed on domestic sentiment during early trade.
summary: Indian equities completed a strong week with Sensex and Nifty extending their winning streak to four weeks amid record FII inflows and gains in banking and auto stocks. Markets digested global pressures from tech selloffs and Federal Reserve rate hike signals. Meanwhile, IndusInd Bank announced the termination of Sumant Kathpalia's services with clawback provisions invoked.
